name: Keeper Isla

intro.text: Mind the ice, it's freshly swept. Welcome to the rink. You've come a long way, and it's a cold place to land.
Frost creatures don't hurry. They just get there first. Sweep hard!

win: Hurry hard, and you did. The Frost Stone. And a pair of waders: the bogs up here will swallow a welly whole.
after: Away and see the Cù-Sìth's glen on Skye, if you dare. Bring a jumper.
